bugs.label: deterministic
bugs.detail: O1 NOT FIXED for the new-customer / interactive-disambiguation path. Across 4 separate book/update_booking attempts (turns 6,7,8,9,10) the backend deterministically emitted next_step=reoffer_slots / tool.response.rejected on slots the agent itself reported as 'validado' and that the DB confirms are genuinely open (0 appointments on Tue 16 June 2026; offered slots 10:00/10:40/11:20 with Marta). This is NOT a sandbox race — same slot, repeated rejects, zero competing rows. Log evidence: agent.tools.book 'tool.response.rejected' next_step=reoffer_slots (11:27:53, 11:28:26, 11:28:29) and agent.tools.update_booking 'tool.response.partial' next_step=reoffer_slots (11:27:32, 11:27:50, 11:28:23).
Date drift: bot agreed to 'sábado 13' (turn 1/2) then offered Tuesday 16 slots without acknowledging the change.

Turn 9: bot told the customer 'el sistema no ha reconocido el servicio en el catálogo' but the pre-resolved service id was valid in the catalog. The real backend failure was reoffer_slots, not invalid_service_ids — the bot mislabeled the failure cause to the user.

o1_verdict: FAIL — O1 (spurious reoffer_slots P0) is NOT fixed for the new-customer / interactive-disambiguation path. book/update_booking deterministically rejected an offered slot that availability_service and the DB both confirm is open (Tue 16 June 2026, 0 appointments). Repeated across 4 attempts on the same open slots → deterministic bug, not a sandbox_artifact race. The bot offered slots, the customer accepted one that was genuinely open, but book did NOT accept it and no appointment was created.

log_signals.reoffer_slots: FIRED (deterministic, 4+ times) — agent.tools.book tool.response.rejected next_step=reoffer_slots AND agent.tools.update_booking tool.response.partial next_step=reoffer_slots
log_signals.invalid_service_ids: NOT fired in backend. The turn-9 user-facing 'servicio no reconocido' message was an LLM mislabel; pre-resolved service id cb7ae91c-97ff-e1d1-3b0b-696b11467add ('Corte de Mujer', adult_female) is valid in the catalog.
